newsitem.title: CHINA: China plans sovereign mark Eurobond issue soon.
newsitem.headline: China plans sovereign mark Eurobond issue soon.

text.p: China plans a sovereign issue of mark denominated Eurobonds in the near future, the official Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The issue would be made by the Ministry of Finance on behalf of the government, the news agency said.
It said the amount was not immediately known but the offer would be aimed at further cultivating the European market and setting standards for other Chinese bond issuers.
CS First Boston and Deutsche Bank would be the co-lead underwriters.
The offer follows a $1.0 billion offer of global bonds in June last year, Xinhua said.
